name: T2K ND280 Upgrade -- Technical Design Report
notes: Submitted to the CERN SPSC 11 Jan 2019; revised Oct 2020, per the source record.

summary.plain: The engineering plan for rebuilding the upstream part of T2K's ND280 near detector with new, more capable technology.
summary.technical: Technical design report for the ND280 upgrade: replaces the P0D with a highly granular scintillator detector (Super-FGD), adds two High-Angle TPCs and six time-of-flight planes, aiming to reduce near-detector systematic uncertainty on the Super-Kamiokande event prediction to about 4% for the T2K-II physics programme.
